scenarios.name: text-32 Observe and restore new Text preset defaults

scenario_steps.name: the user selects Use Current Preset as the new Text default and cancel the existing-text editor
g and its fraction content appear automatically
the user selects Last Used, cancel, and place again
the fraction preview returns with the clock-marked *g selector
Last Used is checked in settings
the user restores No Preset, cancel, and place again
the editor is empty with Tahoma 3.05 mm, purple and width 100
the saved preset g remains listed
